overview_description.description: Revnu Group provides digital marketing and client acquisition systems for service-based businesses, with a focus on trades and home improvement sectors. The company designs and manages full-funnel advertising frameworks that connect online enquiries to booked work. Its services include on-site planning, scripting, and production of video content for campaigns on platforms such as Meta and Google. Revnu Group builds and optimises custom landing pages, lead handling flows, and follow-up sequences to filter and qualify prospects. It deploys AI-driven appointment setting tools that capture enquiries, pre-qualify potential customers, and schedule appointments directly into client calendars. The agency also provides regular performance reporting that tracks lead quality and conversion through to installed jobs. Revnu Group aims to support companies that want marketing activity closely aligned with actual revenue outcomes.
